svg.title: Driver Dreamer — Original Grand Tourer Crest with filled thought bubbles
svg.desc: Three close refinements retain the original Grand Tourer Crest, car, red crown and wordmark. Filled red thought bubbles progress mostly vertically with subtle left drift, right drift or alternating offsets. Each column shows icon-only and icon-with-text versions and an enlarged bubble trail. Original car geometry is retained and no cloud surrounds it. Palette and typography appear below the grid.

g.text: Grand Tourer Crest / V4 / Filled dream bubbles
Original car, shield, crown and wordmark. Three circular bubbles rise toward the car with subtle offsets.

svg.title: Driver Dreamer — Grand Tourer Crest
svg.desc: An original deep navy shield holds a white, front-facing sports car with a low roof and distinctive split headlights. A red crown stripe and three red collection rows connect luxury vehicle discovery with an organized automotive database.

g.text: A gentle rise from the left toward the car.

svg.title: Driver Dreamer — Grand Tourer — Left Drift
svg.desc: An original deep navy shield holds a white, front-facing sports car with a low roof and distinctive split headlights. The original red crown stripe is preserved. Three filled red thought bubbles grow toward the car, with a subtle leftward drift toward the bottom.

svg.title: Driver Dreamer — Grand Tourer — Left Drift
svg.desc: The original Grand Tourer navy shield, red crown, white sports car and Driver Dreamer wordmark are preserved. Three filled red thought bubbles grow toward the car, with a subtle leftward drift toward the bottom.

g.text: A gentle rise from the right toward the car.

svg.title: Driver Dreamer — Grand Tourer — Right Drift
svg.desc: The original navy shield, red crown stripe and white front-facing sports car are unchanged. Three filled red circular thought bubbles replace only the collection rows, with a subtle rightward drift from the largest circle nearest the vehicle to the smallest circle below.

svg.title: Driver Dreamer — Grand Tourer — Right Drift
svg.desc: The original Grand Tourer Crest retains its navy shield, red crown, white sports car and Driver Dreamer wordmark. Three filled red circular thought bubbles replace only the original collection rows, drifting subtly to the right as they descend beneath the vehicle.

g.text: Small alternating offsets around the center.

svg.desc: The original navy Grand Tourer shield, red crown and white front-facing car are retained unchanged. Three filled racing-red circular thought bubbles rise from the bottom toward the car, with subtle alternating left and right offsets. No thought cloud surrounds the car.

The original Driver Dreamer wordmark accompanies the crest.
